rationale: Splits the 6108-line consolidated RULEBOOK.md into navigable segments. The map is TOTAL: every top-level section is assigned to exactly one part, so nothing can be dropped. Parts 1-7 follow the author's seven functional areas; part 0 carries the rules-provenance / process material, which is not a play area and would otherwise have to be misfiled. RULEBOOK.md stays canonical -- the parts are derived from it, and a guard proves the concatenation is byte-for-byte lossless.

parts.title: Meta: rules provenance, process and change ledger
parts.purpose: How the rulebook is governed, versioned and audited. Not player-facing rules.

parts.title: Basic Rules: the resolution kernel
parts.purpose: Attributes, Skills, the check, pools and the portable adapter contract.

parts.title: Character Generation and Progression
parts.purpose: Lifepath creation, identity, advancement and campaign specialist fields.

parts.title: Physical Systems: combat and the body
parts.purpose: Wounds, combat, embodiment and platform rules.

parts.title: Cybernetic Systems: gear, augmentation and cyberspace
parts.purpose: Gear and implants, mesh/hacking/cyberspace, AI agents and equipment lists.

parts.title: Psychic Systems: PSI, psychotronics and the astral
parts.purpose: Psionics, psychotronics, sleep/dreams and manifestation forensics.

parts.title: Social Systems: society, factions and institutions
parts.purpose: Affect/faction/contacts mechanics, NPCs, the simulation layer and UNSA.

parts.title: NoöPunk Lore: world, history and sources
parts.purpose: The setting: history, glossary, four systems, factions, NHI and theory sources.
